description: x.md is a read-only service for fetching public X content such as posts, threads, profiles, followers, following lists, and search results as Markdown or JSON. It mirrors X URLs onto mdfromx.com and also offers an MCP server for the same read operations.
summary: mdfromx.com exposes a public read-only HTTP API on `https://mdfromx.com/api/v1` and a public MCP server on `https://mdfromx.com/mcp`; both are unauthenticated, with an optional hand-issued bearer key documented only to raise search allowance.
